assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package is a reviewable concept submission, but no statutory, parcel-level, demolition, engineering, or implementation conclusion may be drawn until those materials are supplied.

assumptions.statement: The site boundary and all three key-area polygons are repository-maintained provisional rough geometry, not organizer-supplied official polygons.
assumptions.impact: All dependent land-use, building, road, green-space, public-space, phasing, area, and ratio evidence must be regenerated and rechecked when official polygons become available.

assumptions.statement: The Consent Line governance protocol, three civic test grounds, annual event, and operating roles are design references only; no implementing body, budget, or approval has been confirmed.
assumptions.impact: Each pilot requires professional, legal, accessibility, cybersecurity, service-owner, and public-interest review before any real-world trial.
